modify.note: Store isolation: give each weekly Calendar instance its own Zustand store, provided through that instance's context, so changing dates or events in one calendar cannot update another calendar on the same page. Preserve the current consumer API while moving store creation out of shared module-level state. Overlap layout: move overlap calculations into the specified utility module (packages/features/calendars/weeklyview/utils/overlap.ts, per the spec). Sort a copy of the input events, group events by overlapping time ranges, and compute layout information independently for each connected overlap group. When building a group, account for the latest end time across the group so a long event keeps shorter overlapping events together. Events that only meet at an endpoint should not create an overlap. Return each event's group position, horizontal offset, width, and stacking order without mutating its source data, and provide the ID-to-layout lookup for rendering. Bound the cascade by the space available inside a single day column. As a group grows, constrain the offset step and width together so every event remains visible and its right edge stays inside the column, including large groups. Respect the optional layout configuration rather than relying on an unbounded fixed offset. Rendering: apply the calculated positioning in the event component and remove the conflicting horizontal inset rule so CSS does not override the computed width.
